definition: The practice of tracking and managing changes to prompts over time, similar to how source code is version-controlled.
details: Prompt versioning allows teams to test, roll back, and audit changes to prompts used in production, treating prompts as a first-class engineering artifact rather than an informal, untracked text string.
story: Picture a novelist who has read so much that, given a first line, they cannot help but write the next one. It makes new things by recombining everything it has ever seen. The result feels creative because it is memory, reshuffled at speed. It is prediction pushed forward — each next word, or pixel, guessed from everything that came before it. That next-word, next-stroke magic is Prompt Versioning.
